_note: PRD FR-07 / v1.1 §2.10 §2.7 §4 'rules govern safety'. Maps classifier.internal_category -> schemas.DisposalCategory. damage_detected always overrides this map to hazardous_waste regardless of category (PRD v1.1 §2.8: Safety > Disposal > Recovery Value, never reversed) — enforced in code (disposal_engine.py), not here, so it can never be bypassed by editing this file alone.
